name: layout
description: The layout of each page. Structured pages and tables or lists suit the schema markdown_transcription_schema, which keeps headings, marginalia and table rows; single-column and multi-column prose suit plain_text_transcription_schema.

questions.name: layout
questions.instructions: How is the text on the page laid out?

choices.multi_column: Two or more columns of running prose.
choices.table_or_list: A table, or a list of entries such as an index, a register or accounts.
choices.structured: Prose structured by headings, marginalia, footnotes or numbered sections.
